item.title: Second-Year NFL Wide Receivers Ready to Blow Up in 2025
item.description: The 2025 NFL season is shaping up to be the year of the sophomore wide receiver. With wide-open depth charts and offensive schemes begging for someone to step up, guys like Keon Coleman, Malik Nabers, and Marvin Harrison Jr. have a golden chance to claim WR1 roles and light up highlight reels.

item.title: Major League Baseball’s 2025 Trade Deadline: The Biggest Moves, Boldest Swings & Moves You Missed
item.description: Superstars changed jerseys, bullpens got supercharged, and contenders pushed their chips all the way in — but not every big move made headlines. We’re breaking down the biggest splashes and the sneaky steals from a chaotic 2025 trade deadline.

item.title: NFL and ESPN Just Made a Billion-Dollar Trade — You’re the One Paying for It
item.description: ESPN now owns NFL Network, RedZone, and your fantasy app. The NFL grabbed 10% of ESPN in return. Football just got simpler — and more expensive

item.title: Most Valuable NFL Teams in 2025: Full List and Why the Cowboys Are Untouchable
item.description: Not every NFL team is worth $10 billion — but the Cowboys are, and then some. From stadium ownership to merch revenue, Jerry Jones has turned "America’s Team" into a global cash machine.

item.title: NFL Week 2 Best Bets: Dogs, Parlays, and One Big Blowout
item.description: Week 2 lines are out, and we’ve locked in our four best bets — three underdogs with value and one favorite built to blow the doors off. Let’s break down where the sharp money should be this Sunday.

item.title: NFL Week 2: Who’s For Real, Who’s Fraudulent, MVP Sleeper
item.description: Week 2 is in the books — and the NFL picture is starting to sharpen. Some teams are flashing real contender juice (Chargers, Colts, Baker Mayfield?!), while others are showing cracks behind the hype. We’re cutting through the noise — who’s for real, who’s fraudulent, and what it all means heading into Week 3.

item.title: NFL Week 3 Best Bets: Dogs With Bite, Short Favorites, and a Parlay to Ride
item.description: Week 3 is when the NFL really starts to show its hand. Overreactions are everywhere, ugly dogs have real bite, and a few teams are about to get punched in the mouth. Let’s ride.

item.title: MLB to Implement Automated Ball-Strike Challenge System in 2026
item.description: MLB is officially bringing challenge tech to the strike zone. Starting in 2026, teams will get two chances per game to challenge balls and strikes — with Hawk-Eye cameras delivering instant reviews in under 15 seconds. It’s not full robot umps, but it’s a major step toward precision without losing the human element.

item.title: NFL Week 4 Best Bets: Bounce Backs, Short Favorites, and a Matchup Nightmare
item.description: This week’s picks fade the hype and lean into what’s actually happening on the field. We’ve got a few teams being slept on, a defense built to ruin Rodgers, and a bounce-back spot for a squad that just got embarrassed. Let’s ride.

item.title: NFL Week 6 Truth Meter: Who
item.description: We’re five weeks in — time to separate contenders from pretenders. The Jags are surging, the Broncos are better than you think, and the Eagles might be fooling us all.
